title: Landscaping in Jacó: Gardens, Lawns & Irrigation | MA Soluciones
description: Landscaping in Jacó: lawn installation, pruning, palms and automatic irrigation for villas, condos and businesses. 48 h quotes.
lead: We design and maintain gardens in Jacó adapted to the tropical climate: lawns, palms, hedges and automatic irrigation. A well-kept garden is the first impression of your villa, condo or business for guests and customers.
heroAlt: Landscaping work at a Jacó villa, Costa Rica
highlightsTitle: Gardens that look great all year in Jacó

highlights.title: Planting and design
highlights.text: Species selected for coastal sun and breeze, arranged to reduce maintenance and water use.

highlights.title: Automatic irrigation
highlights.text: Programmed irrigation systems that care for the garden even when the property is empty or closed for the season.

highlights.title: Pruning and cleanup
highlights.text: Hedge pruning, lot cleanup and removal of green debris, ready for guest season.

zoneLinkText: Jacó is the tourist and residential hub of the Central Pacific, between Garabito, Herradura and Playa Hermosa. We serve the area from our local base.

faqs.q: Do you maintain vacation villa gardens?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer scheduled visits for mowing, pruning and cleanup, coordinated between guest arrivals.
Yes. We design and install zone-based irrigation with controllers, ideal for properties used seasonally.
